div.head: Grið 14
div.ab: 7 frigman se ðe cwicne on þære mundbyrde geyfelige, sylle XXX scill'.
And frigman se ðe cwicne on þære mundbyrde geyfelige, sylle XXX scillinga.
And a freeman who injures a living person under protection is to give thirty shillings.
Und ein Freier [= jemand], der einen Lebenden [ohne Todtschlag] in dieser Schutzgewalt verletzt, zahle 30 Schill. [der Kirche].
And a free man [= anyone] who injures a living person [without killing] within this protection shall pay 30 shillings [to the church].
div.note: Liebermann notes that 14–18 are also particular to the northern English.
